// An Int sent to a command as a JSON number (ADR-0058): exact within
// ±2^53, and a trap past it rather than a different number.
function exact(v) {
  if (v < -(2n ** 53n) || v > 2n ** 53n) trap("an Int a JavaScript number cannot carry exactly");
  return Number(v);
}

NOT CLAIMED: captures are a patched part. An element carries what its
handler reads as rendered; the store reads only item.id, the loop key.
NOT CLAIMED: an opaque type's invariant is checked at the boundary.
PositiveInt arrives as an s64; the language states no invariant for it.
NOT CLAIMED: the event as a handler parameter. No syntax binds one, the
runtime listens for a click only, and a handler with parameters is refused.
Computation, branches, loops and several commands compile since
2026-09-25 (ADR-0058): just e10-handlers-compute.
